content: GitHub Actions + pnpm monorepo CI: use pnpm/action-setup@v4 with version pinned (or pnpm/setup@v2 for pnpm 11+), actions/setup-node@v4 with cache:'pnpm', then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. In a pnpm workspace, a single root install installs all workspace packages, so parallel jobs each need their own checkout+install (or use a composite action). A known monorepo cache failure mode is that setup-node's cache:'pnpm' caches node_modules, not the global content-addressable store, so each package's symlinks into the store dangle and pnpm reinstalls everything - fix by caching an explicit pnpm store path. Submodules are only fetched when checkout specifies submodules: recursive; jobs that do not need game assets should omit it to avoid a second checkout cost. pnpm -r runs scripts recursively but in parallel by default; use --sort or --workspace-concurrency=1 when build order matters.
